interface.title: IGSN Core XML
interface.tagline: An extensible schema for physical samples.
interface.lead: Explore the IGSN Core 2.0 schema. Find a field, understand its rules, and start with a working XML example.
interface.searchPlaceholder: Try a field, an attribute, or a topic…

interface.notesTitle: Reading the PDF and XSD together

interface.requiredExplanation: Required means that an element must be present inside its parent. If the parent is optional, its required children are needed only when you add that parent.
interface.occurrenceExplanation: 1 means once. 0..1 means optional. 1..n means one or more. Keep elements in the order shown by the schema.
interface.rootDescription: The XML document starts with a resource element. It holds all parts of one sample record.

introduction.title: From a sample to a clear metadata record.
introduction.description: IGSN Core defines shared metadata for samples and sampling features. A domain profile can add more detail for a particular field of research. This guide is for people who describe samples and for developers who work with XML.

steps.title: Start small
steps.description: Open the minimal record. It shows the required elements in the correct order.

steps.title: Find the right field
steps.description: Browse a topic or search for a word. Each element explains its purpose, attributes, and allowed values.

steps.title: Check your XML
steps.description: Use an XML Schema validator with the matching XSD revision. The examples in this guide have been checked against that schema.

rules.title: Names have a namespace
rules.description: Core elements and Core attributes use the igsn prefix. Some reused DataCite types have unprefixed attributes or children with the daci prefix. Follow the examples.

rules.title: Use what you know
rules.description: Add real names, dates, identifiers, and roles. Keep the date precision you know and leave out optional information that is not available.

rules.title: A shared core
rules.description: Core provides a common structure. A full sample description or registration workflow may need a domain profile and further DataCite requirements.

v1.title: Technical rules come from this XSD
v1.description: The field list, occurrences, attribute use, and allowed values are read from the published schema. The FAIR AIMS PDF adds explanations and recommendations.

v1.title: Sample type scheme
v1.description: The PDF calls this attribute sampleTypeScheme. The published XSD spells it sampletScheme. Use sampletScheme to create valid XML. The XSD permits one sampleType per record.

v1.title: Contributor roles
v1.description: The PDF recommends a contributorType. The XSD allows this attribute to be omitted. Add a role when you know it; do not guess a person's role.

v1.title: Polygon coordinates
v1.description: Put coordinateSystem on each polygonPoint. Follow the exact attribute and namespace placement in the XML example.

resource.label: Sample record
resource.description: One metadata record for one sample or sampling feature. This is the root of the XML document.

identifier.label: IGSN identifier
identifier.description: The persistent identifier for this sample. Use its full IGSN DOI.

name.label: Sample name
name.description: A name that people use for this sample. Add further names when the sample has other established names or local names.

agents.label: People and organisations
agents.description: People and organisations connected with this sample, together with the publisher of its metadata.

contributor.label: Contributor
contributor.description: A person or organisation involved in collecting, creating, managing, or sharing the sample.

contributorName.label: Contributor name
contributorName.description: The full name of this person or organisation.

givenName.label: Given name
givenName.description: The given name of the person, also known as the first name.

familyName.label: Family name
familyName.description: The family name, or surname, of the person.

nameIdentifier.label: Person or organisation identifier
nameIdentifier.description: A persistent identifier for this person or organisation. ORCID is useful for people; ROR is useful for organisations.
notes: For ROR, use the full https://ror.org/ identifier.

affiliation.label: Affiliation
affiliation.description: The institution or organisation with which this contributor is associated.

publisher.label: Publisher
publisher.description: The organisation that registered the sample's IGSN and manages its metadata record.

entityTypeClassifications.label: Sample type and description
entityTypeClassifications.description: The broad kind of object, its sample type, its material, and descriptions that help people understand it.

resourceType.label: Kind of object
resourceType.description: The broad kind of object. The PDF suggests material sample or feature of interest when no suitable shared vocabulary is available.

sampleType.label: Sample type
sampleType.description: A more specific kind of sample, such as a rock specimen or a grab sample. Use a shared vocabulary where possible.
notes: Choose one sample type for this record; the XSD allows one sampleType element.

material.label: Material
material.description: What the sample is made of, such as rock, water, or sediment.

alternateMaterial.label: Additional material classification
alternateMaterial.description: Another way to describe or classify the sample's material. This can give a more specific material name from another vocabulary.

description.label: Description
description.description: Text that explains the sample. Select a description type to show what the text describes.
notes: For Other, name the subject of the description, for example Platform: followed by the platform information.

dates.label: Dates
dates.description: Dates for the sample and its metadata, together with the publication year.

date.label: Sample or metadata date
date.description: A date relevant to the sample or its metadata. The dateType attribute explains what the date means.
notes: Keep the precision you know. Do not invent a month or day.

publicationYear.label: Publication year
publicationYear.description: The year when the record was or will be made public. This is different from the year when the sample was collected.

relationshipIdentifiers.label: Related identifiers
relationshipIdentifiers.description: Identifiers for the same sample, its parent, and other resources related to it.

alternateIdentifier.label: Another identifier for this sample
alternateIdentifier.description: Another identifier for the same sample. It must refer to the same object as the main identifier.

parentIdentifier.label: Parent sample identifier
parentIdentifier.description: The IGSN of the parent sample or sampling feature from which this sample comes.

relatedIdentifier.label: Related resource identifier
relatedIdentifier.description: The identifier of another related resource, such as a publication, dataset, or sample.

geoLocations.label: Geographic location
geoLocations.description: Where the sample was collected or where it is relevant. Add place names and the relevant geographic shapes.

geoLocationPlace.label: Place name
geoLocationPlace.description: A place name or a short description of the location.

geoLocationPoint.label: Geographic point
geoLocationPoint.description: A location described by one longitude and one latitude.

geoLocationBox.label: Geographic bounding box
geoLocationBox.description: A rectangular area defined by its western, eastern, southern, and northern bounds.
notes: Give all four bounds in decimal degrees.

geoLocationPolygon.label: Geographic polygon
geoLocationPolygon.description: An area described by a sequence of points along its boundary.
notes: Use at least four points. Repeat the first point at the end to close the polygon.

polygonPoint.label: Polygon point
polygonPoint.description: One point on a polygon boundary, given by longitude and latitude. List the points in their boundary order.

pointLongitude.label: Longitude
pointLongitude.description: The east-west position in decimal degrees. Negative values are west of Greenwich.

pointLatitude.label: Latitude
pointLatitude.description: The north-south position in decimal degrees. Negative values are south of the equator.

westBoundLongitude.label: Western longitude
westBoundLongitude.description: The longitude of the western edge of the area.

eastBoundLongitude.label: Eastern longitude
eastBoundLongitude.description: The longitude of the eastern edge of the area.

southBoundLatitude.label: Southern latitude
southBoundLatitude.description: The latitude of the southern edge of the area.

northBoundLatitude.label: Northern latitude
northBoundLatitude.description: The latitude of the northern edge of the area.

fundingReferences.label: Funding
fundingReferences.description: Organisations and awards that supported work on this sample.

fundingReference.label: Funding reference
fundingReference.description: One funding organisation and, if known, the award that supported this sample or related work.

funderName.label: Funder name
funderName.description: The name of the organisation that provided funding.

funderIdentifier.label: Funder identifier
funderIdentifier.description: An identifier for the funding organisation, such as a ROR identifier.

awardNumber.label: Grant or award number
awardNumber.description: The grant or award number assigned by the funder.

awardTitle.label: Grant or award title
awardTitle.description: The name or title of the grant or award.

language.label: Metadata language
language.description: The main language of the sample metadata.

identifierType.label: Identifier type
identifierType.description: The identifier system used by the value, such as DOI, IGSN, or URL.
notes: The main identifier uses DOI. A parent identifier uses IGSN; the XSD fixes these values in their respective elements.

titleType.label: Name type
titleType.description: The role of this name, for example an alternative or translated name.

lang.label: Text language
lang.description: The language of this text, expressed as a language code.
notes: Check the allowed values for each element. Several fields in this XSD allow only en.

nameType.label: Person or organisation
nameType.description: Whether the name identifies a person or an organisation.

nameIdentifierScheme.label: Name identifier system
nameIdentifierScheme.description: The identifier system for a person or organisation, such as ORCID or ROR.

affiliationIdentifier.label: Affiliation identifier
affiliationIdentifier.description: An identifier for the institution or organisation named in the affiliation.

affiliationIdentifierScheme.label: Affiliation identifier system
affiliationIdentifierScheme.description: The identifier system used for the affiliation, such as ROR.

contributorType.label: Contributor role
contributorType.description: The person's or organisation's role in relation to the sample, such as DataCollector or ProjectLeader.
notes: The PDF marks this attribute as mandatory. In the published XSD it is optional.

publisherIdentifier.label: Publisher identifier
publisherIdentifier.description: An identifier for the publishing organisation or repository.

publisherIdentifierScheme.label: Publisher identifier system
publisherIdentifierScheme.description: The identifier system used for the publisher, such as ROR or re3data.

resourceTypeGeneral.label: General resource type
resourceTypeGeneral.description: The broad DataCite resource category for this record.
notes: The Core XSD fixes this value to PhysicalObject.

sampletScheme.label: Sample type vocabulary
sampletScheme.description: The name of the vocabulary used for the sample type.
notes: The published XSD spells this attribute sampletScheme. The PDF calls it sampleTypeScheme; use the XSD spelling in XML.

subjectScheme.label: Material vocabulary
subjectScheme.description: The name of the vocabulary used to describe or classify the material.

schemeURI.label: Vocabulary or identifier system URI
schemeURI.description: The URI of the vocabulary or identifier system. This is often a web address describing that system.

valueURI.label: Vocabulary term URI
valueURI.description: A URI that identifies this specific term within a vocabulary.

classificationCode.label: Classification code
classificationCode.description: The code for a term in the named classification or vocabulary.

descriptionType.label: Description type
descriptionType.description: The kind of description, such as Abstract or Methods.

dateType.label: Date type
dateType.description: What the date describes, such as Collected or Issued.

dateInformation.label: Date details
dateInformation.description: Extra information that explains a date, especially when dateType is Other.

alternateIdentifierType.label: Additional identifier type
alternateIdentifierType.description: The identifier system used by another identifier for the same sample.
notes: Choose a value from the identifier list. The XSD does not allow arbitrary scheme labels in this attribute.

relationType.label: Relationship type
relationType.description: How this sample is related to the resource named by the identifier.

coordinateSystem.label: Coordinate reference system
coordinateSystem.description: The reference system used for the coordinates.
notes: The XSD fixes this value to WGS84. For a polygon, set it on each polygonPoint.

funderIdentifierType.label: Funder identifier type
funderIdentifierType.description: The identifier system used for the funder's identifier.

awardURI.label: Grant or award link
awardURI.description: A link to the funder's page about the grant or award.
